notes: Governance is the largest block: Executive Committee, Personnel Committee, Corporation Management, staff meetings and school boards (TA, SVA, Board of Education) are about 70 occurrences in the window.

Pastoral care is structured: LEAD peer-group leader meetings, coaching and a seminar (15 LEAD groups per the Visitor), intern meetings, Ministry Development Conference/PROPEL (12–15 Apr 2026, plus Oct 2026 and Jan 2027 dates), and Hispanic pastors’ meetings almost every month.

Church planting is visible: SEEDS church-planting conference, church planters’ meetings/advisory, Church Planting Committee and retreat, two new congregations organised (Aug and Sept 2026), and NAD Bootcamp/Exponential.
Youth and young adults are strong: AYM teen rallies, Youth Fests, "Plug In" for high-schoolers in five regions, public campus ministry, young adult retreat, mission trip, ski day.

Evangelism on the calendar: Hispanic Caravan (17–24 Oct 2026) and "Hispanic Evangelism" (17–24 Apr 2027, just past the window). An earlier Hispanic Caravan of Evangelism (one week, 195 baptisms) was reported in July 2026 without dates.
Hardly any health or community-service events appear on the conference calendar. Adventist Community Services of Greater Washington is a separate organisation.
